results.title: Supported-zero theta and the label-resolved Weil formula
results.calculation: Constructs the full supported-zero theta sum, actual test-to-theta and Mellin maps, the labelled explicit formula, and minimal Fourier-closed endpoint representation. It calculates a nonzero fixed-support trace that is killed by the top arithmetic observation.

results.title: Actual eight-state monodromy and the surviving infinitesimal residue
results.calculation: Calculates the original infinity and heat loops, whole-fibre pairing transport, which maps specialize at collision, and the nonzero residue delta=-T^3 partial_T/16. On the retained radical it induces N/N^2 to N^3 by [n2] mapping to -3n3/8.
results.programme_use: Provides explicit transport and filtration maps for the same signed fibre. The trace may fail to detect the residue while its algebraic map remains nonzero; no action on arithmetic zeta zeros is assumed.
results.verification: Completed owner-reviewed proof edition; exact finite tests supplement the written proofs. Promotion does not claim an independent re-proof of all nineteen arguments.

results.title: Holonomy average and its complete Weil compensation
results.calculation: The actual order-192 signed-root average of the native form is (1/3)P_even+(2/3)P_constant, positive semidefinite. The admissible-test endpoint map and full nonzero compensating term are then computed inside the supported-zero Weil formula.
results.programme_use: Retains both the positive averaged boundary and the precise change in its complement, including all lower support labels. Averaging the auxiliary cover is not declared to prove classical Weil positivity.
results.verification: Completed owner-reviewed proof edition; exact finite tests supplement the written proofs. Promotion does not claim an independent re-proof of all nineteen arguments.

results.title: Prime-circle holonomy and the complete supported-zero Weil formula
results.calculation: Calculates the oriented Connes–Consani prime-circle traces, inertia-invariant local factors, character Euler series, and a convergent contour identity. Their projection is then calculated inside the complete supported-zero Weil formula.
results.programme_use: Gives the explicit class-field input to the existing theta and Weil construction, retaining every lower support label and the analytic complement. It does not assert a general-character spectral realization not constructed in the proof.
results.verification: Completed owner-reviewed proof edition; exact finite tests supplement the written proofs. Promotion does not claim an independent re-proof of all nineteen arguments.

results.title: Class-field character of the full signed eight-state cover
results.calculation: Computes the order-192 group abelianization, a degree-16 common cover, the discriminant character along w²=4−27A², and the field Q(sqrt(-23)) at A=1. The conductor-23 Gauss sum, prime-2 and prime-5 returns, integral order correction at 2, and heat special-fibre maps are calculated explicitly.
results.programme_use: Connects the original eight-state transport to its arithmetic character without discarding the rest of the cover. The character does not detect the retained nonzero infinitesimal map [n2] to -3n3/8; that map and its exact source remain in the proof.
results.verification: Completed owner-reviewed proof edition; exact finite tests supplement the written proofs. Promotion does not claim an independent re-proof of all nineteen arguments.
